title: Megurine Luka — Guiding Hand〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What a beautiful, starlit sky...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't reach any of them no matter how much I stretch my hand out. Hehe... Silly me. Of course I can't.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm sure she can definitely...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, Miku. Finished practicing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Penny for your thoughts, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Well, I was just thinking about her.
Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika... Her true feelings are right in front of her, yet she doesn't seem to acknowledge them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Despite that, she's still doing what she can to reach out to Honami right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I made a wish to the stars that she'll be able to convey her feelings properly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her feelings of wanting to be together like before, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Ichika and the girls don't know Honami's true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why they think allowing Honami to continue sticking close to her other friends may be for the best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope Honami can tell them her true feelings one day too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She may not because she's too good-natured.
That's why she's struggling too. She's not sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not being able to tell the people you like that you want to spend time together is just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just speak your mind. Why the hesitation?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you need me, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you want to be with me forever?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wh-What's this, all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm still waiting for your answer.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. See?
It's not that easy to speak your mind without any hesitation, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: W-Wait a minute, that has nothing to do with this... Oh, come on...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Some things are hard to convey properly, even among those who know each other well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's understandable that those who have drifted apart for a time would be even more cautious as a result.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But they're working up the courage to reach out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're all still within reach, unlike this starlit sky.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're right...
And I'm sure they'll succeed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After all, if Honami is truly already out of Ichika's reach...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her feelings wouldn't be a part of this SEKAI at all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. This SEKAI is full of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The plushies in the classroom, the star chart on the blackboard...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even this beautiful starry night sky is a part of everyone's memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must be something deeply engraved in their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why I said they shouldn't be so hesitant...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I know it's frustrating, but let's have faith in them and watch over them together, alright?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Until they can all find their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, a shooting star.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Great! I'm going to make a wish too.
I wish that the girls will be able to convey their true feelings to each other!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Miku.
